member.name: T:FluxCurator.Core.Domain.ChunkOptions
member.summary: Configuration options for text chunking operations.

remarks.para: All token-based sizes (TargetChunkSize, MinChunkSize, MaxChunkSize, OverlapSize) use estimated token counts based on language-specific heuristics, not actual tokenizer output.

Token estimation ratios by language:
English: ~4 characters per token (512 tokens ≈ 2,048 chars)
Korean: ~1.5-2 characters per token (512 tokens ≈ 750-1,024 chars)
Chinese/Japanese: ~1.5-2 characters per token
Mixed content: weighted average based on character types
For precise token control, verify chunk sizes with your actual tokenizer after chunking.
